A '''pirate''' who had hidden his treasure became marooned on the habitable [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Regretter's Rock]]<ref name="Mission" /> by [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Crime Doesn't Pay" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the ongoing [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to Regretter's Rock, where countless [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] had been marooned over the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], to investigate what else might have been left there. The companion encountered the haggard [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], who agreed to lead them to his treasure in exchange for passage off Regretter's Rock.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The pirate was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Crew Skill mission "Crime Doesn't Pay," though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the video game.<ref name="Mission" />
